::: {#def-irls}

#### Iteratively reweighted least squares (IRLS)

Suppose the outcomes follow the [logistic regression model](#def-logistic-regression).
Let $X$ be the matrix whose rows are $\tp{\vpredvar_\iobs}$.
From a current [estimate](estimation.qmd#def-estimate) $\vcoef^*$ with fitted [probabilities](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) $\prob_i^*$, form

- the weights $w_i = \prob_i^* \paren{1 - \prob_i^*}$, collected in the diagonal matrix $W$;
- the working responses $z_i = \dprod{\vcoef^*}{\vpredvar_\iobs} + \paren{\outvar_i - \prob_i^*} / w_i$, collected in $\vecf{z}$.

**Iteratively reweighted least squares** replaces $\vcoef^*$ by the weighted least squares fit of $\vecf{z}$ on $X$,
the minimizer of $\sum_{i=1}^n w_i \paren{z_i - \dprod{\vcoef}{\vpredvar_\iobs}}^2$,
which is

$$
\inv{\paren{\tp{X} W X}} \tp{X} W \vecf{z},
$$

and repeats until the estimate stops changing.

:::
